evidence.title: EU waste packaging rules: Why small businesses are worried

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR deposit-and-return provisions and EU member-state rollout records
occurrences.quote_span: Deposit-and-return schemes for plastic bottles and soda cans, such as those operational in Germany and the Netherlands, will be rolled out across the EU by 2029.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: European Commission projection of EU discarded packaging waste
occurrences.quote_span: Without PPWR, Brussels says, discarded packaging was set to rise by another 19% by 2030, driven by the boom in online shopping and convenience food.
occurrences.speaker: European Commission
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: change.org petition signature count and petition page
occurrences.quote_span: A petition on change.org had been signed by more than 45,000 people by Wednesday morning, calling on Brussels to "stop destroying EU micro-businesses."
occurrences.speaker: change.org petition
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Elisabeth Dieringer public statement and medium-sized-firm PPWR cost estimates
occurrences.quote_span: EU lawmaker Elisabeth Dieringer of the far-right Freedom Party of Austria has warned that PPWR would mean five-figure costs for medium-sized firms.
occurrences.speaker: Elisabeth Dieringer
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Eurostat 2023 packaging-waste generation data for Germany
occurrences.quote_span: At 215 kg per capita (in 2023), Germany's waste from packaging is much higher than the EU average.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: environmental monitoring and toxicology records on PFAS persistence and bioaccumulation
occurrences.quote_span: PFAS are highly persistent chemicals and accumulate in the body and the environment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation effective-date and PFAS provisions
occurrences.quote_span: new European Union rules take effect on Wednesday, banning high levels of PFAS "forever chemicals" in packaging.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR sustainability provisions and business submissions or public criticisms
occurrences.quote_span: While consumers won't notice any difference, businesses have fiercely criticized the changes, which also require packaging to meet new sustainability standards.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation legal text
occurrences.quote_span: The EU has introduced new rules targeting packaging waste and "forever chemicals."
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PFAS migration studies for food packaging and environmental leaching studies
occurrences.quote_span: Packaging with lower PFAS reduces the risk of these persistent chemicals migrating into food or the natural world when thrown away.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: packaging-material composition studies and manufacturer product specifications
occurrences.quote_span: PFAS are used to make paper and cardboard packaging both grease- and water-resistant and are found in everything from pizza boxes to TV dinners.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: European Commission packaging-waste statistics
occurrences.quote_span: EU countries have witnessed a 20% increase in packaging waste over the last decade.
occurrences.speaker: European Commission
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Händlerbund warning or public statement about PPWR
occurrences.quote_span: "Instead of facilitating cross-border trade, the new rules threaten to make it significantly more difficult," warned Händlerbund, the German online retailers' association.
occurrences.speaker: Händlerbund
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR penalty provisions and German enforcement law
occurrences.quote_span: EU states will be able to set their own penalties for non-compliance, with German authorities allowed to impose fines of up to €200,000 ($230,000) for more serious breaches.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: EU briefing transcript or source data on European plastic consumption
occurrences.quote_span: Packaging also ⁠accounts ⁠for about 40% of plastic consumption in Europe, an EU official told reporters at a briefing on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: EU official
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR binding packaging-waste reduction targets and compliance reports
occurrences.quote_span: Although PFAS is the main focus of this initial phase of PPWR, the EU has set binding targets to cut packaging waste by 5% by 2030 and 15% by 2040.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Eurostat packaging-waste generation statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Each EU resident generates the equivalent of roughly half a kilo of packaging waste every day, data from Eurostat, the EU's statistics agency, shows.
occurrences.speaker: Eurostat
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: peer-reviewed epidemiological and toxicological research on PFAS
occurrences.quote_span: PFAS have been linked to increased risks of certain cancers and other health conditions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Monstaas Workshop cost statement and invoices or compliance fee schedules
occurrences.quote_span: "The cost is around €300 ($346) per country, per year ... these costs are simply not affordable."
occurrences.speaker: owner of Monstaas Workshop
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR food-contact packaging compliance provisions
occurrences.quote_span: Under the EU's Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), any new packaging products entering the market will now have to meet tighter standards if designed to come into contact with food.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: small-business shipment records and public statements
occurrences.quote_span: some small sellers have already paused shipments due to the additional red tape.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: iLabs Electronics website announcement and order records
occurrences.quote_span: Swedish embedded electronic devices maker iLabs Electronics said it would halt web shop orders from EU countries.
occurrences.speaker: iLabs Electronics
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR labeling requirements and implementing regulations
occurrences.quote_span: From 2028, packaging manufacturers will be required to carry standardized labels that clearly show the materials used and how it should be recycled or disposed of.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR ban provisions and enforcement records
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, single-use plastic packaging for fresh produce will be banned from 2030.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: EU BPA restriction regulation and effective-date notice
occurrences.quote_span: The new rules are in addition to curbs on bisphenol A (BPA) in food-contact materials, which took effect across the EU last month.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: iLabs Electronics website statement
occurrences.quote_span: "The cost and administrative burden [of PPWR] is now out of proportion to our direct sales volume," iLabs wrote on its website.
occurrences.speaker: iLabs Electronics
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Eurostat and European Commission packaging-waste and recycling time series
occurrences.quote_span: Recycling rates in the EU are rising, but lower than the increase in packaging waste
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Monstaas Workshop Instagram post and PPWR authorized-representative requirements
occurrences.quote_span: "Under these rules, I would need to appoint an authorized representative in every single EU country I send to," wrote the owner of a small online store, Monstaas Workshop, in an Instagram post.
occurrences.speaker: owner of Monstaas Workshop
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Händlerbund member notice and PPWR applicability provisions
occurrences.quote_span: Händlerbund warned its members : "There is no minimum quantity and no exception for small businesses."
occurrences.speaker: Händlerbund
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: business shipping notices and delivery records
occurrences.quote_span: Several businesses, from sole traders to medium-sized firms, said they had paused deliveries to and within the EU due to the new rules.
occurrences.speaker: several businesses
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR transitional and stock provisions
occurrences.quote_span: Under PPWR, businesses will not be required to recall or destroy packaging or goods that were already on the market before Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Elisabeth Dieringer X post dated August 11, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: EU lawmaker Elisabeth Dieringer of the far-right Freedom Party of Austria has warned that PPWR would mean five-figure costs for medium-sized firms. "While corporations have their own departments for this [red tape], the Mittelstand [medium-sized firms] has little choice but to 'eat or die,'" she wrote on X on Tuesday.
occurrences.speaker: Elisabeth Dieringer
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR recyclability requirements and market-compliance audits
occurrences.quote_span: Then from 2030, all packaging placed on the EU market, including single-use plastic bottles, must be designed to be recyclable.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: food-packaging exposure studies and scientific risk assessments
occurrences.quote_span: Although the amount of material people are exposed to from food packaging is usually low, scientists are worried about the long-term effects.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: national packaging producer-responsibility registries and fee schedules
occurrences.quote_span: They complain that they now have to register their packaging in multiple EU states, often with fees.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: European Commission time series for packaging waste volume and recycling rates
occurrences.quote_span: According to Brussels, the volume of waste has grown faster than recycling rates over the past decade.
occurrences.speaker: European Commission
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR reuse and refill obligations and national implementation rules
occurrences.quote_span: Some stores, particularly restaurants and cafes, will be required to offer customers reusable packaging as an option, often at no extra charge.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: PPWR packaging-minimization requirements and implementing standards
occurrences.quote_span: Packaging will also be required to be kept to a minimum to protect the product and fulfill its function.
occurrences.speaker: European Union
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Eurostat 2023 plastic packaging waste and recycling dataset
occurrences.quote_span: Of this, 35.3 kg was plastic packaging, only 42% of which was recycled.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation

occurrences.checkable_against: Eurostat packaging-waste generation dataset for 2023
occurrences.quote_span: EU data shows that 178 kilograms (392 pounds) of packaging waste was generated per person across the bloc in 2023.
occurrences.speaker: EU data
occurrences.subject: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation
